16 open-source Chromecast projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered Chromecast Google Cast devices. 9 of 16 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: AirConnect, castnow, catt, pychromecast, owntone-server.
